snippet.title: SpiritVale Trailer
snippet.description:
Hello! I’m Phil and I’ve been building SpiritVale, a class-based indie MMORPG inspired by old school games, with a focus on Combat, Exploration, Loot Hunting and Party Play.

I started this project solo and got it playable in about 6 months. Still lots to do, but it’s already got bosses, 10+ maps, 100+ equips, 100+ cards and plenty of hats. With the 5 base classes currently playable.

🎮 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3767850/SpiritVale/
💬 Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/u3ZZQFFG3v

I’ll be posting updates, gameplay clips, and progress here as I keep working towards Early Access in 2025.

#MMORPG #IndieGame #WishlistOnSteam
